U-picture-them.text: I think for speech at least. I want that to show up in a like right click menu. on all messages. Um I wanna be able to right click something and then have it like read aloud using my speech api key? i think we should also add a "dumb" (but still modern and pleasant) tts engine built into the app, with a setting that lets users swap for a fancier cloud voice model via api key (kinda similar to how we offer "dumb" model naming or ai-assisted naming).
